links.outcome: Readability of LLM-simplified patient leaflets against NHS standards across five indices
links.effect: All three LLMs significantly improved readability across all indices (p<0.001); Gemini met targets on 3/5 indices; no model consistently met all NHS standards.
links.quote: Despite significant improvements, no model consistently met all NHS standards.

links.outcome: LLM-revised PIL readability versus NHS thresholds
links.effect: All three LLMs improved all readability indices (p < 0.001); Gemini met 3/5 thresholds (FRES 80.35 ± 4.31, FKGL 4.73 ± 0.79, CLI 6.77 ± 0.59); none met all.
links.quote: Despite significant improvements, no model consistently met all NHS standards.

links.outcome: readability of LLM-generated patient education materials
links.effect: all three LLMs significantly improved readability (p < 0.001), but unrestricted LLM-generated materials still failed to meet recommended NHS literacy standards
links.quote: LLMs can improve comprehension; however, unrestricted LLM-generated materials still fail to meet the recommended NHS literacy standards, highlighting the need for targeted frameworks to improve readability.
